notes: Model-aware part gotchas. When the finder recognises the laptop, it now shows a note specific to THAT model and THAT part at the top — e.g. a ThinkPad T14s tells you its RAM is soldered (not upgradable) and its charge port is soldered to the board (a board-repair job), while an Inspiron 15 tells you its charge port is a modular DC jack on a cable (quick swap). Covers charge port, RAM and storage across the common Dell / HP / Lenovo / Asus / Acer / Apple / Surface / MSI models, plus a few keyboard notes. Figures are trade-typical and hedged where builds vary — always confirm against the machine in front of you.
